correctness.rationale: PASS: The specified Haken–Strobl Lindblad generator damps off-diagonal entries at gamma and trap population at kappa; the Hilbert–Schmidt dissipation equality excludes nonzero imaginary-axis invariant eigenoperators for gamma>0 by the connected bipartite graph. Permutation averaging of one localized source is justified by survival-trace invariance. Integrating the eight entry equations gives C_N=N/kappa+(N-1)kappa/(4 J^2 b) and T_A=C_N+(a-1)(N-2)/(2gamma+kappa)+(a-1)/gamma+N gamma/(2J^2 b), T_B=C_N+a(N-2)/(2gamma+kappa)+(b-1)/gamma+(N-1)gamma/(2J^2 b). Direct independent N^2-dimensional complex Liouvillian solves for (m,n)=(2,2),(3,2),(4,3), for both source sides, agree within floating errors around 3e-15. Strict convex derivatives yield the B positive optimum, A positive optimum iff a>=2; at a=1 coherent capture on the reachable sector is proved despite other dark eigenvectors. Scaling gamma=x sqrt(b) yields source constants J sqrt(a-1), J sqrt(a+2) and excess constants sqrt(a-1)/J, sqrt(a+2)/J. The finite solves are corroboration, not the all-size proof.
